title: Conic Sections: Circle, Parabola, Ellipse and Hyperbola
seo_title: Conic Sections Class 11 Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 10)
standard_text: Sections of a cone: circle, ellipse, parabola, hyperbola, a point, a straight line and a pair of intersecting lines as a degenerated case of a conic section; standard equations and simple properties of parabola, ellipse and hyperbola; standard equation of a circle (summary of the CBSE syllabus)
meta_desc: Class 11 Conic Sections worksheet (NCERT Chapter 10): circles, parabolas, ellipses and hyperbolas in standard form: centre, radius, focus, directrix, foci, vertices, eccentricity and latus rectum. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Ellipse: c² = a² − b², e < 1. Hyperbola: c² = a² + b², e > 1.
key_sub: Parabola y² = 4ax: focus (a, 0), directrix x = −a, latus rectum 4a.
body_html:
How it works

  • Circle: (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r², centre (h, k), radius r.
  • Parabola y² = 4ax: vertex (0, 0), focus (a, 0), directrix x = −a, latus rectum 4a.
  • Ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (a > b): foci (±c, 0) with c² = a² − b², e = c/a < 1, latus rectum 2b²/a.
  • Hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1: foci (±c, 0) with c² = a² + b², e = c/a > 1, latus rectum 2b²/a.
Example

Find the foci and eccentricity of x²/25 + y²/9 = 1.

a = 5, b = 3, c = √(25 − 9) = 4

e = 4/5

Answer: (±4, 0), e = 4/5

Common mistakes

  • Taking r² as the radius.
  • Using c² = a² + b² for an ellipse.
  • Putting the focus of y² = 12x at (12, 0) instead of (3, 0).

faq.q: How do I know which axis is the major axis?
faq.a: The larger denominator goes with the major axis.

items.q: Write the equation of the circle with centre (2, 7) and radius 9.
items.e: Standard form: (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r². With centre (2, 7) and r² = 81: (x − 2)² + (y − 7)² = 81.

items.q: Find the centre and radius of (x − 8)² + (y + 2)² = 36.
items.e: Change the signs inside the parentheses: centre (8, −2). The right side is r² = 36, so r = √36 = 6.

items.q: Find the radius of the circle x² + y² + 4x + 8y + 11 = 0.
items.e: Centre (−2, −4), and r = √(g² + f² − c) = √9 = 3.

items.q: Find the centre and radius of the circle x² + 10x + y² − 6y = 2.
items.e: Complete the square: add (10 ÷ 2)² = 25 and (−6 ÷ 2)² = 9 to both sides, so the right side becomes 2 + 25 + 9 = 36. The equation is (x + 5)² + (y − 3)² = 36. Centre (−5, 3), radius 6.
